roadmap.title: First runs
roadmap.description: Pass the opening assessment, take your first elevator ride, and fail one mission.

roadmap.title: Depth 1 clears and Ramrod extras
roadmap.description: Reclaim a Depth 1 facility, kill your first Gatekeeper, finish one Intel clearance level and a Deployment, and gather four players in the showers.

roadmap.title: Depth 2 facilities
roadmap.description: Reclaim a Depth 2 facility and kill a Ramok Gatekeeper.

roadmap.title: Depth 3 facilities
roadmap.description: Reclaim a Depth 3 facility and kill a Molaktula Gatekeeper.

roadmap.title: Depth 4 facilities
roadmap.description: Reclaim a Depth 4 facility and kill a Balgorath Gatekeeper.

roadmap.title: Level and Ascend every class
roadmap.description: Take each of the five Reclaimers to level 15 and Ascend them.

roadmap.title: Ascension perks
roadmap.description: Watch a friend's Ascension, then clear a facility with another class's Bio-Booster deck.

roadmap.title: Standard Gauntlet
roadmap.description: Survive a Standard weekly Gauntlet with an Ascended Reclaimer.

achievements.description: You passed your Post-Cryonic Aptitude Assessment. Now get to work.

steps.text: Look for the Post-Cryonic Aptitude Assessment when you first start the game. It is most likely the opening tutorial, so play it through to the end.

achievements.description: You've had your first bitter taste of failure.
achievements.summary: Fail a mission for the first time.

guide.context: A failed mission still gives partial rewards and progress.

steps.text: Start a mission at the @loc{Mission Terminal} and let every player die, or let the timer run out until the endless enemies arrive and wipe the team.
Solo, @npc{Cooper} revives you, so let him run out of revives too.

achievements.description: Successfully complete an entire run without getting downed.
achievements.summary: Finish an entire run without being downed.

guide.context: Swarms arrive on the timer and when you start an Expenite Event or the elevator. Do not start two at once. Keep teammates up too, since a teammate going down may also count.

steps.text: Pick a Depth 1 mission at the @loc{Mission Terminal}, ideally a short one.
Take the @mechanic{elevator} on every stage without going down.
Defeat the @enemy{Gatekeeper} at the end. Shoot its exposed weak points.

guide.context: Ascension is tracked for each class, so every class needs its own. You earn Merits from Directives and Deployments at the Operations Command terminal and from Gauntlets.

steps.text: Play missions as the Spotter until that class reaches level 15. It stops gaining XP at that level.
Open the @loc{Ascension Terminal} outside the Ascension Hall on the @loc{Ramrod} and pay the Merits it asks for to Ascend the Spotter.

guide.context: Ascension is tracked for each class, so every class needs its own. You earn Merits from Directives and Deployments at the Operations Command terminal and from Gauntlets.

achievements.summary: Ride an elevator for the first time.

steps.text: Follow the cable from the start outpost to the @mechanic{elevator} and activate it.

achievements.description: Fully complete every task in any single Intel clearance level.
achievements.summary: Complete all four Intel tasks of one Clearance level.

guide.context: Tasks include reclaiming a facility, recovering security cameras, summoning a Gatekeeper and downloading terminal data. Cameras often hang on high structures, so look up.

steps.text: Open the @loc{Mission Terminal} and read the four Intel tasks of your current Clearance level.
Do those tasks in missions. Progress carries over between missions, and the same task progresses together.
Claim the rewards at the terminal once all four are finished.
Choose a Depth 1 mission at the @loc{Mission Terminal}.
Go down stage by stage and defeat the @enemy{Gatekeeper} at the bottom to win the mission.

guide.context: Depths open as your Intel Clearance rises. Enemies hit harder and the timer is shorter each Depth.

steps.text: Choose a Depth 2 mission at the @loc{Mission Terminal}. If you have not unlocked it, join a friend's lobby at that Depth.
Go down stage by stage and defeat the @enemy{Gatekeeper} at the bottom to win the mission.

guide.context: Depths open as your Intel Clearance rises. Enemies hit harder and the timer is shorter each Depth.

steps.text: Choose a Depth 3 mission at the @loc{Mission Terminal}. If you have not unlocked it, join a friend's lobby at that Depth.
Go down stage by stage and defeat the @enemy{Gatekeeper} at the bottom to win the mission.

guide.context: Depth 4 is the hardest. Bring a full set of high-level Enhancements first.

steps.text: Choose a Depth 4 mission at the @loc{Mission Terminal}. If you have not unlocked it, join a friend's lobby at that Depth.
Go down stage by stage and defeat the @enemy{Gatekeeper} at the bottom to win the mission.

guide.context: Killing a Gatekeeper seals its gate at the same time.

steps.text: At the @loc{Mission Terminal}, pick a facility whose Gatekeeper is the Gotoorak.
Reach the Gate at the end of the last stage and fight the @enemy{Gatekeeper}. Its armor plates cannot be broken, so shoot its exposed weak points.

guide.context: Killing a Gatekeeper seals its gate at the same time.

achievements.description: Complete and claim a daily Deployment assignment.
achievements.summary: Complete a daily Deployment and claim its reward.

guide.context: Deployments are tied to a class. They open when you reach their rank.

steps.text: Open the @loc{Operations Command} terminal on the @loc{Ramrod} and start a Deployment that is open for your class.
Finish its objective in missions.
Return to the terminal and claim the reward.

achievements.description: You survived a standard weekly Gauntlet and lived to tell the tale.

guide.context: A Gauntlet fails if the timer runs out or everyone dies. You can retry, but the rewards pay once.

steps.text: Ascend one Reclaimer. Gauntlets unlock after a Reclaimer's first Ascension.
Open the weekly @mechanic{Gauntlet} on the @loc{Ramrod} and start the Standard one.
Reach the kill goal on each of the 7 levels to open the elevator, and have every player in the elevator before the timer turns critical.
Reach the final kill goal on level 7 to call the drop pod.

achievements.description: You beat one of OMEGA's extra-spicy weekly Gauntlets. Badass.
achievements.summary: Complete one of OMEGA's harder weekly Gauntlets.

guide.context: The run fails if the timer ends or everyone dies. Fights never pause, and the kill goals grow each level.

steps.text: Open the weekly @mechanic{Gauntlet} on the @loc{Ramrod}. Choose the harder Advanced Gauntlet if it is offered next to the Standard one.
Reach the kill goal on each of the 7 levels to open the elevator, and have every player in the elevator before the timer turns critical.
Reach the final kill goal on level 7 to call the drop pod.

achievements.description: Reclaim a facility with another class' Bio-Booster Deck equipped.
achievements.summary: Reclaim a facility with another class's Bio-Booster deck equipped.

steps.text: Ascend one Reclaimer to unlock deck swapping. If swapping is still locked, Ascend a second one.
In the @loc{Loadout Terminal}, equip a Bio-Booster deck that belongs to a different class.
Win a mission by defeating the @enemy{Gatekeeper}.

achievements.description: Hidden achievement. Four Reclaimers must be together in the showers of the Ramrod.
achievements.summary: Get four Reclaimers into the Ramrod showers together.

guide.context: This needs four players. The achievement is hidden.

steps.text: Form a lobby of four players on the @loc{Ramrod}.
Have all four walk into the showers at the same time.

achievements.description: Witness the Ascension Ceremony of a fellow Reclaimer.
achievements.summary: Witness a fellow Reclaimer's Ascension Ceremony.

steps.text: Stay on the @loc{Ramrod} near the Ascension Hall while a friend Ascends a Reclaimer.

guide.context: Balgorath came with Update 03, together with Depth 4.

steps.text: At the @loc{Mission Terminal}, pick a facility whose Gatekeeper is the Balgorath.
Reach the Gate at the end of the last stage and fight the @enemy{Gatekeeper}. Its armor plates cannot be broken, so shoot its exposed weak points.
